resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because the face captured in the packet was flagged as an invalid capture, in some cases alongside an invalid face on the matched candidate record. An invalid face capture cannot support the comparison the update depends on.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a biometric update, which requires a valid face capture to compare against the record being updated. The photograph in the packet breached capture-quality rules, so the comparison could not be performed on a sound image and the packet was rejected with de-duplication candidates still outstanding. A new packet with a fresh photograph that follows the capture guidelines is required.
